page.overview:
What is Blaster rifle?

Blaster rifles were weapons more powerful and larger than other types of blasters, such as blaster pistols. It was used in various factions.

Pulse cannons were powerful blaster rifles. Assault rifles were modular versions of the blaster rifle. Longblasters had high precision and power over long ranges. Boiler rifles were illegal weapons. Stun rifles were a type of blaster rifle and stun weaponry. The Relby-v10 micro grenade launcher, blaster spear, bo-rifle, and the SP-B50 blaster rifle were blaster/hybrids.

Blaster rifle length ranged from the short E-11 and DC-15A blaster carbine to the longer A280 and DC-15A blaster rifle. Rifles almost always had a scope, a fully automatic firing mode, and some kind of stock. Other forms of blaster rifles included blaster carbines, heavy blaster rifles, light repeating blasters, and sniper rifles.
